description: Golden fixture corpus for the raw-core filename-template engine (#2628). Each case feeds render_filename(template, RenderInputs, SequenceOptions) and asserts the result against `expected`: either { "ok": "<rendered name>" } or { "error": "<FilenameError::kind() tag>" }. Consumed directly by raw-core's own tests_fixtures.rs (Rust reference) and intended for the cross-surface outcome-parity harness (#2633) to replay identically against the Swift, TypeScript/WASM, and C# bindings of the same engine so a template is proven to produce byte-identical output — or byte-identical rejection — on every surface.

cases.name: original_only
cases.description: {original} token alone

cases.name: ext_only
cases.description: {ext} token alone

cases.name: literal_only
cases.description: no tokens at all — pure literal text

cases.name: original_plus_ext
cases.description: {original} + literal '.' + {ext}

cases.name: sequence_no_padding
cases.description: {n} with pad_width=0 renders the bare number

cases.name: sequence_padding_3
cases.description: {n} zero-padded to 3 digits

cases.name: sequence_start_100
cases.description: configurable sequence start value

cases.name: sequence_index_advances
cases.description: n = sequence_start + sequence_index

cases.name: sequence_padding_never_truncates
cases.description: pad_width is a floor, not a cap — a wider number is never truncated

cases.name: repeated_sequence_token
cases.description: {n} used twice in one template renders the same value both times

cases.name: date_basic
cases.description: {date:%Y-%m-%d} from a parseable EXIF DateTimeOriginal

cases.name: date_time_compact
cases.description: compact date+time stamp directive combo

cases.name: date_two_digit_year
cases.description: %y is year modulo 100, zero-padded to 2 digits

cases.name: date_percent_literal
cases.description: %% renders a literal percent sign

cases.name: date_unknown_directive_passthrough
cases.description: an unrecognised %-directive is copied through verbatim, not an error

cases.name: date_missing_fallback
cases.description: captured_at absent (null) falls back to the documented sentinel text

cases.name: date_unparseable_fallback
cases.description: captured_at present but not EXIF's exact YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS shape falls back the same as absent — never a panic or a hard error

cases.name: date_empty_format_spec
cases.description: {date:} with an empty FORMAT and a present, parseable date renders zero characters (not the fallback — the date IS known, the format just says print nothing)

cases.name: combined_full_template
cases.description: every token in one realistic batch-rename template

cases.name: unknown_token
cases.description: a {...} block that isn't a recognised token name is a template-parse error

cases.name: unterminated_token
cases.description: a '{' with no matching '}' is a template-parse error

cases.name: empty_template_result
cases.description: an empty template with no literal text renders the empty string, which is rejected

cases.name: path_separator_forward_slash
cases.description: a forward slash in the rendered output is rejected on every platform, not just POSIX

cases.name: path_separator_backslash
cases.description: a backslash is rejected on every platform, not just Windows

cases.name: leading_dot
cases.description: a leading dot is rejected (would create a hidden file on POSIX)

cases.name: trailing_dot
cases.description: a trailing dot is rejected (Windows restriction, enforced everywhere)

cases.name: trailing_space
cases.description: a trailing space is rejected (Windows restriction, enforced everywhere)

cases.name: reserved_exact_con
cases.description: bare CON is a reserved Windows device name

cases.name: reserved_case_insensitive
cases.description: the reserved-name check is case-insensitive

cases.name: reserved_with_extension
cases.description: CON.txt is reserved — the check applies to the stem before the extension, not just the bare name

cases.name: reserved_double_extension
cases.description: con.tar.gz is reserved — the check uses the FIRST dot, not the last

cases.name: reserved_lpt1
cases.description: LPT1 is a reserved Windows device name

cases.name: reserved_com9
cases.description: COM9 is a reserved Windows device name

cases.name: non_reserved_similar_prefix
cases.description: a name that merely STARTS WITH a reserved word (not an exact stem match) is accepted

cases.name: sequence_pad_width_at_maximum
cases.description: sequence_pad_width at the engine's maximum (32) is still accepted — the bound rejects values GREATER than the max, not the max itself

cases.name: sequence_pad_width_just_past_maximum
cases.description: sequence_pad_width one past the engine's maximum (33) is rejected — the memory-DoS guard: pad_width feeds format!'s allocation size directly, and this engine is reachable from FFI/WASM/the Self Hosted API
